doc.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012

title: Mancini gives him Sounds and Scores
summary: Mancini returned three nights and gave Weber his orchestration book, which became his Bible.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well I’m not sure, you were talking about what do you give them?

Yeah, what do you give them. So Hank Mancini, he came back the next two nights, three nights in a row, and he gave me a book, this is the reason I brought it up. He gave me a book called Sounds and Scores which had the range of every instrument, the range in

which they’re comfortable, all the things I’d ever want to know about orchestration were in that book. So that helped a ton. I learned a little bit, it sort of backed up everything that I’d learned on my own, but there it was in black and white, and that’s my Bible. I refer to that often.
